description: AICTIONBOT™ blanket order guard by KULIC Advisory (tool 55). Takes blanket or limit purchase orders (order, value, called off so far, start, end; optional supplier and open invoices not yet booked). Returns per order the remaining budget, the share used, the use per month, the day the budget is expected to run out compared with the end of the term, invoices that are not covered, a traffic light and the next step (top up, renegotiate, framework contract instead of an order, follow-up order). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Blanket orders: order, supplier, value, called_off, open_invoices, start, end. German column names work too (Bestellung, Wert, Abgerufen, Offene Rechnungen, Beginn, Ende).
